Facts from research/110-faa-ground-stop-factpack.md. NOT yet checked by a second model. A DEVELOPING story: the date-and-time card must be right at posting time.
_rules: Jokes aim at Meatball only; never at passengers, controllers, crews or the agencies' people, and no joke says or hints that flying is unsafe. Unconfirmed causes stay attributed (reports, not confirmed). No joke adds a number, a cause or a claim. All drawn: no airline or agency logos, no real aircraft liveries, no likeness of real people. Captions soften swear spelling (cap_swap). YouTube cut: mild words only. Title, description and caption are clean.

lines.say: Every flight in America just got grounded. Here's what the hell happened.
card: AS OF FRI NOV 13, 7 PM ET
lines.vis: Frame 0: an airport gate window with a row of parked generic planes; a departures board flips every row to DELAYED. Meatball in front with a carry-on.

lines.say: Meatball's at gate B twelve with a nine dollar pretzel and nowhere to fucking go.
lines.vis: Meatball on a gate seat holding a giant pretzel, suitcase beside him.

lines.say: Friday afternoon, the FAA ordered a nationwide ground stop. Every U.S. airport. Planes already in the air kept flying to where they were going.
lines.vis: A drawn map outline of the US with little parked plane icons; a few planes in the air finish their arcs and land.

lines.say: The Transportation Secretary said a communication issue hit all the air route traffic control centers. Those are the people who talk to the planes. Kind of fucking important.
card: ALL AIR ROUTE TRAFFIC CONTROL CENTERS
lines.vis: A generic control tower and a radar room with headsets on a desk; the speech lines between tower and plane go to static.

lines.say: The FAA's wording: extraordinary circumstances, and for reasons of safety. Meatball uses that exact excuse to skip the gym.
lines.vis: Quote card; cut to Meatball on his couch next to an unused gym bag.

lines.say: CBS News, citing sources, reports a network update made the system reboot and crash. Not confirmed. If true, the worst update and restart in fucking history.
card: REPORT: A NETWORK UPDATE, THEN A CRASH
lines.vis: A server rack with an UPDATING progress wheel; the lights go dark; a NOT CONFIRMED stamp.

lines.say: The White House says there's no indication of a nefarious act, and officials say it's not related to Thursday's Microsoft outage. Meatball unplugged his toaster anyway.
card: NO INDICATION OF A NEFARIOUS ACT
NOT RELATED TO THE MICROSOFT OUTAGE (OFFICIALS)
lines.vis: A padlock, intact; then Meatball at home pulling a toaster plug out of the wall.

lines.say: As of this video, there's no timeline for when flights take off again. Meatball's pretzel is gone. Morale is low.
card: AS OF FRI NOV 13, 7 PM ET
lines.vis: The departures board still all DELAYED; Meatball stares at an empty pretzel wrapper.

lines.say: He called his cat, Sauce, to say he'd be late. Sauce had already taken his side of the bed.
card: SAUCE TOOK HIS SIDE OF THE BED
lines.vis: Split: Meatball on the phone at the gate; at home the orange cat, Sauce, lies stretched across Meatball's pillow.

youtube_description:
Why are all flights grounded today? The FAA ground stop explained, as of Fri Nov 13, 2026, 7 pm ET. The FAA ordered a nationwide ground stop for all U.S. airports on Friday afternoon, citing "extraordinary circumstances" and "reasons of safety." The Transportation Secretary said a communication issue hit all the Air Route Traffic Control Centers. Planes already in the air continued to their destinations. CBS News, citing sources, reports that a network update made the system reboot and crash; that is not confirmed. The White House says there is no indication of a nefarious act. This is a developing story: check your airline and the FAA for the latest. The jokes are ours; the facts are sourced below.
